mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sys_role WHERE role_key = #{roleKey} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sys_user_role (account_id, role_id) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{roleId})
mapper.select: SELECT role_key FROM v_account_roles WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
SELECT DISTINCT permission FROM v_account_perms WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY permission
SELECT DISTINCT perms FROM sys_menu WHERE perms IS NOT NULL AND perms != '' AND status = 1 ORDER BY perms

SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_type, m.perms, m.path, m.component, m.icon, m.sort_order, m.visible FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 WHERE ur.account_id = #{accountId} AND m.status = 1 AND m.menu_type IN ('C', 'F') ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.sort_order, m.id

SELECT m.id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_type, m.perms, m.path, m.component, m.icon, m.sort_order, m.visible FROM sys_menu m WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.menu_type IN ('C', 'F') ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.sort_order, m.id
